definitions.explanation: A person's former girlfriend. A casual, colloquial term common in conversation and on social media.

examples.japanese: {元|もと}カノに{偶然|ぐうぜん}{会|あ}った。
examples.english: I ran into my ex-girlfriend by chance.

examples.japanese: {元|もと}カノの{写真|しゃしん}をすべて{消|け}した。
examples.english: I deleted all the photos of my ex-girlfriend.

examples.japanese: {元|もと}カノと{別|わか}れてから、もう{一年|いちねん}になる。
examples.english: It has already been a year since I broke up with my ex-girlfriend.

notes:
Colloquial contraction of {元|もと}の{彼女|かのじょ} ('former girlfriend'), with カノ written in katakana. Common in casual speech and text messages.

RELATED WORDS:
- {元|もと}カレ: ex-boyfriend
- {彼女|かのじょ}: girlfriend
- {元彼女|もとかのじょ}: the same word written more fully
